description: HIGH RISK: void one open request (native:<id>) and close the person's agreement To-do. Requires confirmLive: true (refused before any request otherwise, reason CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED) and a reason of up to 200 characters, recorded on the evidence chain. The signing link retires and a chained REQUEST_VOIDED event is appended; nothing is deleted. A SIGNED or COMPLETED request stands and an already VOIDED one is refused: REQUEST_NOT_READY with details.status. todoClosed is false when the To-do was already resolved. Receipt-backed: the same idempotencyKey replays the stored outcome. Requires agreements:write. Requires the agreements family flag and the agreements_native rollout; denials carry details.reason (AGENT_SURFACE_DISABLED, AGREEMENTS_DISABLED, TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED).

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key sent as the Idempotency-Key header. Same key + same payload replays the stored outcome (replayed: true); same key + a changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_agreements_requests_void
